name: Structural and Materials Engineering
provenance: Classroom positions traced from UC San Diego EH&S floor plans dated July 2021. Room outlines are simplified; floor alignment and heights are approximate.

coordinateSystem.description: Upper-floor reference frame: approximately 1 unit per 10 rendered pixels. Individual page scales are normalized by corresponding lab-wing walls; these units are not meters.
coordinateSystem.northNote: The north arrow printed on each plan points up.

Only scheduled rooms have interior polygons. Other spaces are represented by the approximate floor silhouette.
All 13 schedule rooms present in the existing SME Facilities floor listings have traced polygons.
The other offices, research rooms and service spaces remain unmodeled; the floor silhouette is approximate.
The original Facilities file remains available unchanged. Its four unscheduled shapes are not carried into this coordinate system because they do not establish a reliable whole-building alignment.
Floor registration is approximate: corresponding rectangular lab-wing corners establish relative scale and alignment. The basement plan is drawn larger than the upper floors.
Floor heights are illustrative. No campus placement or meter scale is claimed.
